An asset is classified as NPA if interest or principal remains overdue for 90 days.

Standard assets are not NPAs. NPAs are classified as sub-standard, doubtful, or loss.

SARFAESI Act enables banks to recover NPAs without court intervention.
Which of the following is a 'Stressed Asset'?
Stressed assets include NPAs, restructured loans, and standard assets that are at risk.
The 'Debt Recovery Tribunal' (DRT) handles recovery of debts above
DRT handles recovery of debts above ₹10 lakh.
Which of the following is the 'Provisioning Coverage Ratio' (PCR)?
PCR is the ratio of provisions to NPAs, indicating how much of NPAs are covered by provisions.
B) A company that acquires NPAs from banks
ARCs acquire NPAs from banks and financial institutions to help clean their balance sheets.
Which of the following is the 'Net NPA Ratio'?
Net NPA Ratio = (Gross NPAs - Provisions) / Total Advances.
OTS allows NPA borrowers to settle their dues at a discounted amount.
Which of the following is a 'Wilful Defaulter'?
A) Borrower who cannot pay due to business loss
B) Borrower who has capacity to pay but does not
C) Borrower who fled the country
A wilful defaulter is one who has the capacity to pay but deliberately does not, or has fled.
The 'Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code' (IBC) was enacted in
IBC was enacted in 2016 to provide a unified framework for insolvency resolution.
Which of the following is the 'National Company Law Tribunal' (NCLT)?
B) A quasi-judicial body for insolvency cases
NCLT is the adjudicating authority for insolvency cases under IBC.
The 'Credit Information Bureau' helps banks by
B) Sharing credit history of borrowers
Credit information bureaus share credit history to help banks assess borrower risk.
Which of the following is a 'Stressed Asset' resolution mechanism?
OTS, SARFAESI, and IBC are all mechanisms for resolving stressed assets.
The 'Gross NPA Ratio' is calculated as
Gross NPA Ratio = Gross NPAs / Total Advances × 100.
Which of the following is the 'Asset Quality Review' (AQR)?
B) RBI's inspection of bank asset quality
AQR is RBI's comprehensive inspection of bank asset quality.
The 'Prudential Norms' for income recognition require banks to
A) Recognize income on accrual basis only
B) Recognize income only when actually received for NPAs
D) Recognize income on cash basis only
For NPAs, banks can only recognize income when actually received, not on accrual basis.
Which of the following is the ' SMA' (Special Mention Account)?
B) An account showing signs of stress before becoming NPA
SMA accounts show early signs of stress and are precursors to NPAs.
